verses.text: Yahweh told Moses, ‘Go to Pharaoh. I’ve made his heart and his officials’ hearts stubborn so I can show them my signs, 📣
‘and so you can tell your children and grandchildren what I did to Egypt and what signs I performed there. Then you’ll know I am Yahweh.’ 📖
Moses and Aaron went to Pharaoh and said, ‘This is what Yahweh, God of the Hebrews, says: “How long will you refuse to humble yourself before me? Let my people go worship me. ⚖️
“‘If you refuse, tomorrow I’ll bring locusts into your land. 🦗
“‘They’ll cover the ground so completely you won’t see it. They’ll eat whatever the hail left behind, including every tree growing in your fields. 🌳
“‘They’ll fill your houses, your officials’ houses, and every Egyptian’s house—more than your ancestors or their ancestors ever saw.’” Then Moses turned and left Pharaoh. 🏠
Pharaoh’s officials asked him, ‘How long is this man going to keep trapping us? Let the people go worship Yahweh their God! Don’t you see Egypt is ruined?’ 😟
Moses and Aaron were brought back to Pharaoh. He said, ‘Go worship Yahweh your God. But who exactly is going?’ ❓
Moses replied, ‘We’re all going—young and old, sons and daughters, flocks and herds. We have to hold a feast for Yahweh.’ 👨‍👩‍👧
Pharaoh said, ‘May Yahweh be with you if I let you take your little ones! You’re clearly planning trouble. 😠
‘No! Only the men can go worship Yahweh—that’s what you asked for!’ Then Moses and Aaron were driven out of Pharaoh’s presence. 🚪
Yahweh told Moses, ‘Reach your hand over Egypt. Let the locusts come and eat every plant the hail left behind.’ 🦗
Moses raised his staff over Egypt, and Yahweh sent an east wind across the land all day and night. By morning, the wind had brought the locusts. 🌬️
Locusts spread over all Egypt and settled across the whole country. It was a devastating swarm—nothing like it had ever been before, and nothing like it would happen again. 🦗
They covered the ground until it went dark, and ate every plant and every bit of fruit the hail had spared. Nothing green remained on any tree or plant anywhere in Egypt. 🌑
Pharaoh quickly called Moses and Aaron back. He said, ‘I’ve sinned against Yahweh your God and against you. 🙏
‘Please forgive my sin just this once. Pray to Yahweh your God to take this deadly plague away from me.’ 😔
Moses left Pharaoh and prayed to Yahweh. 🙏
Yahweh sent a powerful west wind that swept the locusts away and carried them into the Red Sea. Not one locust remained anywhere in Egypt. 🌬️
But Yahweh made Pharaoh stubborn, and he wouldn’t let Israel’s people go. ⚠️
Yahweh told Moses, ‘Reach your hand toward the sky, and darkness will cover Egypt—darkness so thick you can feel it.’ 🌑
Moses reached his hand toward the sky, and thick darkness covered Egypt for three days. 🌑
People couldn’t see one another, or get up and move around for three days. But every Israelite home had light. 🕯️
Pharaoh called Moses and said, ‘Go worship Yahweh. You can take your children too, but leave your flocks and herds behind.’ 🗣️
Moses answered, ‘You also have to give us animals for sacrifices and burnt offerings, so we can sacrifice to Yahweh our God. 🐑
‘Our own livestock is coming too—not one hoof will stay behind. We need the animals to worship Yahweh our God, and we won’t know which ones we’ll need until we get there.’ 🐄
But Yahweh made Pharaoh stubborn, and he refused to let them go. ⚠️
Pharaoh said to Moses, ‘Get out of here! Don’t ever show your face to me again. The day you see me again, you’ll die!’ 😠
Moses answered, ‘Fine. You won’t see my face again.’ 🚪
